x-semantic-invariants: request return_context is byte-identical to result return_context

CollaborationDefinitionApplicationV1.description: CollaborativeDefinition of section 12 and CWR-032. A committed sheet is fully described by its revision. Kind fields appear only on their kind. There is no substitution policy field: an unavailable chosen model blocks Start (CWR-034).

permission_ceiling_ref.description: Shown and never configured upward (CWR-032); a reference to the inherited ceiling, not a setting.

stuck_policy.description: What happens when a participant is stuck (CWR-032); default ask_user. Under every value no participant is swapped, skipped or waived without an explicit user action. The value set beyond the default is not closed by the owner.

evidence_citation_rule.description: The evidence each Review finding must cite (CWR-025); default file_and_line. The owner fixes only the default, so the value set stays open.

pause_between_rounds.description: DL-231 / CWR-044: Chat Room only. False when absent on existing definitions. The sheet snapshots its Settings default when it opens; commit writes the current draft choice into the definition. set_pause_between_rounds changes it at the next round boundary without cancelling a turn.

grill_me_enabled.description: DL-218: turns the grilling Skill on in the existing coordinator or moderator; adds no ParticipantSpec. False when absent on legacy reads; migrate old Grill Me slots before validating current definitions (CW section 17).

CollaborationRunApplicationV1.description: CollaborativeRun of section 12. A run admitted by Crew Auto records the crew_auto_revision that admitted it (CWR-021); a Build With Crew run binds the exact Plan (CWR-023). stop_reason is set on every cancelled run and on no other; a run stopped at its own limit settles cancelled with a limit stop_reason and never failed, with no new run state (CWR-029, DL-131).

CollaborationParticipantApplicationV1.description: Requested participant identity (CW sections 2.2 and 12; DL-218). Wonderer has its own model and Persona. Grill Me is only grill_me_enabled on the definition; its Skill is loaded into the existing coordinator or moderator, never into a participant spec.

CollaborationMessageApplicationV1.description: The single durable transcript record for all four kinds (section 2.3).

CollaborationQuestionBankApplicationV1.description: One QuestionBank per collaboration_run_id for BrainStorm and for a Crew/Chat Room with Grill Me on. kind matches the owning run. Crew and Chat Room baseline_limit is zero and effective_limit is the extension alone. Normalize legacy brainstorm_run_id only for BrainStorm. QMAX-005..007 owns charging and QMAX-014..015 owns typed exhaustion; the routed set lives here.

brainstorm_run_id.description: Compatibility-only BrainStorm spelling of collaboration_run_id; normalize to one bank, never a second counter. When both are supplied their values must agree.

CrewAutoApplicationV1.description: The committed Crew Auto criteria read by evaluate(criteria, request_features) (section 5.3, CWR-021). The complexity threshold's value set is the owner's configuration and is not closed here.

CoordinationProjectionApplicationV1.description: coordination_agent_projection.v1:{project_id}:{agent_id} (SP-320 projection rules). The registration's lineage, the current status, the current operation, the count of active claims, the revision and the last applied event; once terminal, the terminal family, its reason or status and its time. Registration sets queued; coordination.agent_unregistered sets its terminal_status, coordination.agent_crashed sets failed and coordination.agent_aborted sets cancelled (OSI-438). The row stays after the terminal event, with no active claims.

CoordinationCheckpointApplicationV1.description: The value at projector.checkpoint.coordination:{project_id} in redb's checkpoints table: pm.storage_value.coordination_projector_checkpoint.v1@1.0.0 (SP-320). It explicitly adopts SP-278's generic EventRecord index checkpoint and stores the nine-field durable read token, never redb_snapshot_id (DL-076). admitted_event_types is the sorted exact list of coordination event types that were admitted in the registry when this publication was built. A proven empty source has null bounds and cursor; a nonempty source with no coordination event keeps its examined bounds and cursor. The same-key generation set is the current core plus at most two retired cores (RP-PROJECTION-3GEN).

result_schema_ref.description: Owner-resolved output schema for compact_result; not a result-supplied permissive fallback.

result_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact original resolved output-schema UTF-8 bytes.

result_schema_dependencies.description: Exact reference-to-original-byte-SHA-256 map for the complete nonlocal schema dependency closure. Empty for a self-contained schema; no ambient or unpinned resources.

storage_key.description: reserved; canonical keys are owned by Plans/storage_value_registry.json rows

MemoryViewApplicationV1.description: What an export hands the artifact owner, which returns the ArtifactExportResult. The scope decides which lists may hold entries.

GoalStartRequestApplicationV1.$comment: Existing exact central GoalStart definition. Goal-specific surface namespace from latest CAT family paragraph; not old generic UI source_surface. Owner rejects surrogate code points without changing accepted scalar/whitespace content. Empty objective remains structurally allowed. Explicit actual creation authority is not supplied by this JSON.

GoalUpdateRequestApplicationV1.$comment: Complete exact replacement. Existing source_surface is routing lineage only, not a new route grant. Direct Save and actual approved proposal are independently authenticated by owner. No caller authority object admitted.

IdentityEnvelopeApplicationV1.description: Explicit application-or-Project operation scope with exact controlling Server, execution Host, Environment, and topology bindings. named_plan_id is only a NamedPlan identity and is nullable when no NamedPlan participates.
